items.text: Greetings mortals,
Pain comes in many flavours, but, no bugs please, it's a waste of good suffering.
Crashes
Fixed an issue related to the Inscribed Skull item that was conflicting with players’ inventories and stashes. It was removed and put back.
A patch for Nintendo Switch 2 is coming in the future…
Hello mortals,
There are more improvements and fixes for you...
Save Data & Demo Import
The full game now offers to transfer a Demo save the first time it is played.
Visuals & Level
Added FSR, DLSS, and XeSS frame generation.
Combat & Enemies
Cultists now hear takedowns more consistently.
Gameplay
Sliding now makes noise that enemies can detect.
The forced movement stop no longer occurs in the “Lights out” corridor.
Audio
The difficulty screen now features a more intense audio cue when hovering over each difficulty option.
UI & UX
Added a high-contrast on/off option to the Main Menu.
Updated the interaction prompt on the Leviathan model puzzle to clearly separate turning the puzzle from rotating the view.
Updated the game credits.
Progression & Softlock
Fixed the lever not appearing after saving and reloading, which blocked progress during the corpse search in the flooded room late in the game
Fixed the player getting stuck during the second battle with Bruno.
Fixed Bruno's blood clipping through closed doors and leaving the player stuck.
Fixed crafting during the death screen leaving the game stuck.
Fixed the game becoming blocked after interacting with Zora's shop.
Fixed the player getting stuck in a corner between two sofa chairs in the Club after being flinched.
Fixed the Chatterer chase in the Labyrinth failing to load correctly after multiple respawns and reloads.
Fixed the player and the Chatterer getting stuck during the first chase in the Labyrinth.
Fixed the player getting stuck behind a gate in the church grounds plaza.
Fixed the player being unable to enter the Labyrinth on the first try after the Sister of Mercy stealth section.
Fixed a collision that prevented finishing the Charlotte chase.
Fixed teleport destinations not loading in time, which caused the player to fall through the Labyrinth.
Fixed Charlotte getting stuck on a rock ledge during her boss fight.
Fixed the ladder prompt disappearing in the room with many TVs.
Fixed a column collapse in the Labyrinth blocking Aidan from moving forward.
Fixed the player getting stuck in the saw blade trap room.
Fixed a collision at the Detective’s body that was blocking the way back after reloading an autosave.
Fixed the player being able to escape the playable area in Bruno's mansion.
Fixed the player getting trapped between collisions outside the Church near the end of the game.
Fixed several holes in the level geometry that let the player fall out of the playable area.
Fixed players falling through the ground and becoming stuck after climbing the ladder out of the sewer area.
Achievements
Fixed the Trapper achievement unlocking after damaging one enemy with a bear trap instead of 10.
Fixed some achievement progress not importing from the Demo.
Combat & Enemies
Fixed the banish prompt being unavailable when the Unworthy are staggered in a door frame.
Fixed the banish prompt being absent on an Unworthy after the room where the player obtains Hellchains.
Fixed an enemy losing the ability to climb through a window when another enemy was banished nearby.
Fixed the Unworthy trying to reach the player through the wall of the well.
Fixed the legs of an Unworthy bisected by a shotgun following the player in the attic and being impossible to kill.
Fixed Bruno sliding while stabbing the player.
Fixed Bruno's submergence into blood form being interrupted by gunfire.
Fixed Bruno no longer moving after the player has been killed by him and respawned.
Fixed Charlotte twitching near floodlights during a stealth encounter.
Fixed Charlotte not charging the player when they climbed a particular stone wall.
Fixed the Chatterer having trouble getting onto his path in the first chase.
Fixed the Chatterer getting stuck behind a wall in the second chase and, in rare cases, killing the player through it.
Fixed the Sister of Mercy sometimes not appearing in the stealth section cutscene and then killing the player during the chase.
Fixed Cultists being offset during finishers and left idle afterward.
Fixed Cultists sometimes looking disoriented without reason.
Fixed Cultists despawning in the player's line of sight.
Fixed Cultists playing the “flinch” animation through level walls.
Fixed Cultists sometimes not shooting at the player when they should.
Fixed a male Cultist having a female voice and getting stuck in the small chapel.
Fixed Armoured Cultists getting behind a door they should not be able to.
Restored a desk collision in the early game.
Fixed one of Zora's nearby doors granting invisibility from Cultists when crouching beside it.
Fixed the takedown option appearing long before the player receives the knife.
Gameplay
Fixed the burning bar and extinguish prompt sometimes failing to appear after catching fire from gasoline, leaving the player burning until death.
Fixed the player dying from fire with no weapon in hand while trying to put out the flames.
Fixed automatic weapons and tools continuing to fire or animate without input after closing the Inventory or Pause menu on a controller.
Fixed fuel continuing to spill from a fuel canister after a single button press.
Fixed the player having too little time to remove a bear trap during a scripted Charlotte sequence.
Fixed the player sprinting forward when pressing backward after running into a wall.
Fixed the player moving forward with backward input after being grabbed by the Sister of Mercy.
Fixed the heal animation not activating with a bandage or medkit while facing Zora.
Fixed the player being able to interact with Hellchains and Storage or Zora at the same time.
Fixed Hellraiser difficulty not actually changing if adjusted during gameplay.
Fixed the Labyrinth tower challenge being skippable by sliding.
Fixed Zora's shop door opening when moving backward while crouched.
Fixed Zora's shop stock resetting to the first level after changing difficulty and dying to the Sister of Mercy.
Fixed the shotgun being impossible to pick up despite free inventory space.
Fixed upgrades disappearing when switching upgrades without enough inventory space.
Fixed the mask treasure item being impossible to pick up.
Fixed Deluxe Edition ‘Nailers’ not appearing for players where they should.
Save Data & Demo Import
Fixed a safe in the park that was not retaining its ‘opened’ state after opening.
Fixed the equipped tool being lost and the player loading empty-handed after loading a save made with a full inventory and a bear trap or fuel canister in hand.
Fixed the player's hands appearing with an empty gun after continuing a Hellraiser difficulty game from the Main Menu.
Fixed the no load option being available in the Pause or Main Menu after changing from Hellraiser difficulty to Normal.
Fixed the flashlight becoming permanently unavailable after reloading the autosave following the Bruno boss fight.
Fixed weapon trinkets remaining unlocked in older saves and new games until the game was restarted.
Fixed an issue where removing the extended magazine mod in Storage duplicated or deleted ammo and overlapping items.
Cinematics
Fixed in-game cutscenes with Bruno and Marlowe being incorrectly framed or cut off on ultrawide resolutions.
Fixed the victim disappearing from the cutscene when the player takes the knife.
Fixed Aidan's hair missing from one shot of a cinematic.
Fixed a white screen appearing instead of a Leviathan Gaze cinematic.
Fixed the final Sister of Mercy stealth cutscene being skipped by minimizing the game.
Visuals & Level
Fixed the SMG having no muzzle flash when the BD SMG weapon skin is equipped.
Fixed the SMG bullets having a broken material.
Fixed an overly long blood splash after hitting a Cultist with the regular Knife.
Fixed the laser beams in the Club appearing black.
Fixed the Hellpriest having no legs when turning away from the player.
Fixed the stretched head of an exploding Unworthy during the battle with Charlotte.
Fixed Zora's eyebrows popping in and out.
Fixed a texture issue on Cultist fingernails.
Fixed the wrong material on the robes in Bruno's mansion.
Fixed glass objects being visible through the Embracer's red blindness effect.
Fixed the bookshelf animation being offset.
Fixed a dark plane appearing in the sky in the Tunnels.
Fixed lighting not loading correctly after respawning during a chase.
Fixed persistent frame drops during and after combat with Cultists following the first takedown.
Fixed dynamic shadows flickering in shallow puddles on low and medium presets when using the flashlight.
Fixed the rope missing from the victim's wrists until Aidan interacts with the knife.
Fixed interactable objects being visible through the Configuration.
Fixed input lag when using VSync, including with certain frame generators.
Audio
Fixed voice-over playing over the Pause menu.
Fixed missing sounds for the elevator opening and the bag zipper.
Fixed colliding with a door triggering a glass-shattering sound.
Fixed sounds not being correctly positioned in the game world.
Fixed missing background crowd sounds from rooms adjacent to the VIP Area.
Fixed the bear trap having no sound when it snaps open.
Fixed missing rolling, pushing, and collision sounds on fire extinguishers.
Fixed the Main Menu electric buzzing continuing into gameplay.
Fixed missing interaction sounds on gas canisters.
Fixed the manual save interaction audio being out of sync on Hellraiser difficulty.
Fixed the Bruno banish sequence sound continuing after skipping it.
Fixed Charlotte's scream looping after the chase.
UI & UX
Fixed Inventory, Map, and Crafting being unavailable after the Hellchains tutorial.
Fixed mouse buttons being unbindable.
Fixed Tab being impossible to bind correctly.
Fixed the controls layout so it's impossible to change back to the default.
Fixed Full Screen being unavailable in Display Mode.
Fixed the game switching to 3840x1080 instead of the native 5120x1440 resolution on 32:9 displays.
Fixed the safe puzzle numpad in the Graveyard house only being navigable with the left stick.
Fixed interaction indicators briefly appearing in the air.
Fixed missing D-pad and left stick controls when examining an item right after entering Storage.
Fixed the HP bar sometimes not showing during combat.
Fixed the SMG and Colt sharing the same ammo icon.
Fixed the entire mansion map turning green before entering, with only one room turning red.
Fixed the shader precompilation progress bar remaining visible after precompilation finished.
Fixed the loading screen briefly scaling before loading ended.
Fixed a linked Saber.games account becoming invalid after entering gameplay and returning to the menu.
Fixed VSync being turned on by default.
Fixed the restart warning not appearing when switching back to an upscaler with frame generation enabled.
Fixed Xbox controller preventing Main Menu selection while plugged in.
Fixed DualSense being detected as an Xbox controller and the controller selection not being saved.
Localization
Fixed the "Press Any Key" text missing from the welcome screen.

topNew: The full game now offers to transfer a Demo save the first time it is played.

items.text: Hello mortals,
Read below to see what our cultists have fixed for the demo…
Save Transfers
Fixed several achievements not correctly carrying their progress over when importing a save from the Demo into the full game.
Fixed the Demo save-import prompt not being localized.
Gameplay & Movement
Fixed the Chatterer going idle during the chase.
Fixed a cultist turning unnaturally at the edge of the chase area.
Fixed a ranged cultist not shooting at the player in combat.
Fixed the player getting up through assets during a flinch animation.
Fixed missing blood VFX material on telekinesis attacks with PlayGo on.
Fixed timing for proximity-triggered sequences (dialogue, environment changes, player animations).
Fixed a crash on Hard difficulty.
Fixed the player getting stuck on a door during the sprint tutorial.
Fixed several blockers and softlocks.
Puzzles & Progression
Fixed an auto-rotate on the 3D diamond puzzle with a controller.
UI & HUD
Fixed the "Import" button text not fitting inside the button.
Audio & Music
Fixed Bruno saying two overlapping voice lines after a respawn.
Fixed cultist banter volume dropping unnaturally near Bruno's office.
Fixed armored-cultist combat music starting too early in the Tunnels.
Fixed combat music cutting out incorrectly when climbing a ladder during the Kitchen/Storage fights.
Fixed Charlotte's hands-falling sound effect being too quiet near Bruno's office.
Fixed an incorrect music cue triggering near Bruno's office.
Added missing crowd chatter in the VIP rooms.
Added missing interaction sounds for gas bottles and fire extinguishers.
Added an ambient sound in the Altar Room.
Fixed Aidan's ladder step-down sound not matching the surface.
Visuals & Lighting
Fixed a lightbulb's light visibly moving on the bulb as the player approached or moved away.
Fixed mesh holes with an exposed skybox edge at a few spots.
Fixed a flickering shadow in one room.
Fixed visible gaps in the Chatterer Chase door/wall.
Fixed a popping shadow near the knife pickup before the takedown tutorial.
Fixed overly strong light/flashing from the Negatoscopes in Bruno's office.
Fixed a door sign that was shown in Russian instead of English during the Charlotte chase.
Cinematics
Fixed stray VFX during the cultist "Slaying Victim" sequence.
Fixed a cultist replaying his dragging animation loop.
Fixed Charlotte shaking during the cliff cutscene before the second chase.
We hope you are suffering beautifully, but if you should encounter something too tormenting, submit a ticket to the support team:

How is the torment going? We hope you are pleased with the things you are seeing… If you saw something unsightly, well, it is now resolved. For those who opened the box on consoles, your patch is coming soon.
Read below to see a small bit of what our cultists have been working on…
Added a startup notice that tells you when your GPU driver is out of date and needs updating.
Fixed an issue that caused the player to fall through the floor after climbing the ladder out of the sewers.
Fixed a collision issue that could stop you from finishing the Charlotte chase.
Fixed levels not loading in time after Sunny's pillar teleport, which could make you fall through the world in the labyrinth.
Fixed Charlotte sometimes getting stuck on the rock ledge during her boss fight.
Fixed the Flooded Room lever not spawning if you saved and reloaded partway through the corpse puzzle.
Fixed the victim disappearing in the cutscene when you pick up the knife.
Fixed a rare bookshelf animation offset.
Reduced visible pop-in of geometry and lighting when backtracking through the dungeon, the Chatterer chase and a stairwell area.
Removed placeholder "Burning House" text that showed through a window in the labyrinth.
More patches are to come…
Hello mortals.

We have been watching, and to our delight, you have been wonderfully vocal. Your feedback has given us much to think about, and we are pleased to see the demo reviews hit Overwhelmingly Positive. A pleasurable sight for all of us.
The feedback you have provided has helped our team fall into the darkest corner, uncover the most pressing issues, and start implementing remedies. A patch for the demo is out now.
Until then, continue to test your limits. If you discover something worthy of our attention, leave your words in the forums.
We will be watching.
Happy suffering…
Fixed several cases where the player could become stuck or softlocked during movement, combat, and environmental interactions.
Fixed an issue where player input was permanently frozen when combining certain actions simultaneously.
Fixed Quick Turn proximity trigger conditions.
Fixed aim state persisting after rebinding the Aim key.
Fixed multiple enemy behaviour issues, including incorrect animation loops, combat state triggers, and VFX playing after death.
Fixed cultist audio lines overlapping during encounters.
Fixed incorrect tutorial hints.
Adjusted Leviathan Puzzle shadow rendering.
Fixed Tutorial messages and Objectives disappearing from the HUD after changing settings mid-gameplay.
Fixed Journal Collections not updating after reading entries or listening to dictaphone recordings.
Multiple mixing and volume adjustments.
Fixed several audio triggers firing incorrectly or missing entirely.
Fixed multiple lighting issues across Prologue and Episode 1.
Fixed graphical artifacts on character models and book textures.
Fixed physics and collision issues on environmental objects.
Fixed incorrect resolution detection on multi-monitor setups.
The executable file is now digitally signed and will no longer be flagged as an unsecure app.
Fixed Aidan's hair missing during the Prologue Outro cinematic.
